- Confluence/GitHub migrate: no rank, notes, or owner.

- Unclear leftovers: VPC Peering / FGT + MGMT “what is left? add NB network?”; EBS Encryption CA/UT “what do we have left?”; Zabbix “what is left?”.
- Victor Epic: “Unknown” / “maybe remove?”.
- Remove/redo: Overlay/OSPF UT and OSPF overlay to carriers; Single OCIP is Q1 27'.
- Empty Keep flags on several EXISTING rows; NETE-316 only notes “tyson”.
- ntopng spend and FortiClient ADVPN still pending approval; AWS overlay depends on HA; Fortigate BOYL depends on LaaC v2.
- Typos in source: “Secuirty”, “centerlized”, “dive to github”, “PHASES”/story-point template not applied per epic.
- No priority column beyond Rank; no status except Keep/Remove/Unknown/*NEW*.
